text:
maria: Quick thought — can we run a lightweight prober that simulates low-tier traffic to validate cost-aware fallback decisions? want to measure token delta vs perceived quality (latency + small eval).

kai: yes. idea: prober service that sends identical prompts to N variants (full, quantized, distilled) and logs latency, token usage, model score. do metrics per-tenant + region. keep load tiny to avoid noise.

oliver: Important: prober responses must be marked internal so they don't count against customer usage. Use meter_tag `prober.synthetic` and internal tenant id. Otherwise billing mess.

anya: we also need to record routed_variant and chosen_reason in traces. Console should surface "fallback rate" and average token-savings per request bucket.

sophie: UX: add a toggle in rollouts page: "Enable synthetic prober for this tier" with sampling rate slider. default off for prod. show histogram + recent diffs.

maria: sketch prober config (wip):
```yaml
prober:
  sampling: 0.02 # 2% of tier traffic
  tenants: ["low-tier-synthetic"]
  prompts: ["short q", "long q with context"]
  variants: ["gptx-1", "gptx-1-quant", "gptx-1-small"]
  meter_tag: "prober.synthetic"
```

kai: add note: run as canary job per-region to catch regional model availability/regressions. collect p95 latency + quality delta (BLEU/embedding-sim).

oliver: telemetry-wise: add two new metrics: `fallback.invocations` (labels: tenant_tier, region, variant_from, variant_to) and `fallback.token_savings`.

anya: alerting: create regression alert when fallback causes >5% drop in eval score for 12h or token_savings < expected by 20%.

sophie: one more: make the console allow manual override per-tenant to opt out of cheap-variant routing.

maria: deployment plan: 1) prod-disabled flag + prober job 2) enable for internal tenants 3) surface results in staging rollout page 4) pilot with 3 customers 5) grad roll. owners: kai (prober infra), oliver (telemetry schema), sophie (console UX), anya (alerts)

deploy-bot: deploy queued: prober-service v0.3 -> staging :rocket:

prober-bot: sample prober run result: {"tenant":"low-tier-synthetic","region":"us-west1","from":"gptx-1","to":"gptx-1-quant","token_savings":23,"quality_delta":-0.9,"latency_p95_ms":210}

maria: sounds good. @kai can you PR the prober config + prober metrics README? aim EOD Fri. :thumbsup:

kai: on it. will add tests for meter_tag and sampling semantics.

oliver: I'll land telemetry changes once metric names are final.

anya: i'll draft alert runbook after we see first week of data.

sophie: will mock console panel — sending link soon.

maria: thanks team — keeping this thread for updates.
